correctness.rationale: Gradient matrix and axis determinant prove exactly three excluded characteristic-five parameters; every smooth fiber has genus 10. Čech Frobenius coefficient formula yields a symbolic ten-by-ten matrix with exactly twelve nonzero entries A=-t(t-2)^2(t+2), B=2t(t+2), D=2t(t-2)^3, reproduced by a standalone exact verifier and independently by polynomial expansion. Six paired coordinates plus a two-dimensional invertible block give rank8, while two dimensions vanish. The decomposition persists under each Frobenius twist, proving 5-rank8 rather than merely one-step Hasse rank8. t=0 gives zero matrix and a-number10; nonzero smooth t gives a-number2. No finite extrapolation is used.

This arithmetic information is not a routine restatement of the published automorphism/inflection data, and the exact smoothness boundary makes it a natural complete result.
